notes.title: UI/Menus Update! - 1.3.6 Update
notes.content:
Hey Topplers! At long last we reach another Topple Tactics update!


The version number of the new update is 1.3.6, if you see a different version number in the main menu and Steam isn’t updating the game for you, the quickest way to get the update is to restart your Steam. If you are still on the old version you will not be able to see games from the new version, so make sure you download the update!
[hr][/hr]
Today we are peeling back the mysterious game code and revealing the stats for your mini player abilities or huge player towers! The menus in the game have been updated with a focus on making choices clearer and explaining how the game works. Let's take a tour!


New Mini Player Shop Screen
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/fa949218809ac552291e2c2160ad861195de919b.png"]

The Item shop screen and Stats screen are now visible at the same time! Lots of changes make this menu more helpful to read and use

All stats now show their numerical value that the game is using. Now you can see exactly what power is going into your build.

Ability Strength stat & Shield Health stat start off locked (aka not upgradable) until you actually buy an item that uses those stats.

Previously, it was unclear to the player that upgrading shield health added no value if you didn't have a shield equipped. The same is true for Ability Strength, which we also handle with the next feature:

In the top right of the Items shop window, text hints will appear to show all of the special abilities you currently have from your items! Abilities also include an icon to show which stat they are primarily impacted by. Here is the full list of Abilities depicted in the menu:

Knockback resistance:

Low Health Doesn't Increase Knockback (Colossus Helmet)

Immune To Being Knocked Over (Chonky Boots)

Ability Strength: *More info about Ability Strength updates below.

Activatable Invulnerability (Enchanted Helm)

Activatable Forcefield (Forcefield Bandana)

Deflector (Electro-Magnetic Shoes)

Dash (Ninja Bandana)

Super Dash (Two Ninja Bandanas)

Jump Height:

Double Jump (Double Jump Shoes)

Super Double Jump (Cloud Shoes)

Shield Health:

Regenerating Forcefield (Regenerative Forcefield)

Walk Speed:

Immune to Ice and Wind (Spiky Cleats)

When hovering over any upgrade button, or any item button, the stat numbers update showing the change the upgrade will have! 

If an item changes your stats in a positive way, green text will appear previewing what that change will be. 

If an item negatively changes your stats, the preview text will be red.

When items add or remove abilities to your character you can also see those abilities highlighted in red if they'll be deleted, or green if they'll be added.

We standardized the use of the green "Tactic Tokens" icon everywhere that cost values are listed, for easy reading.

All of the hover texts have been updated to more accurately reflect the changes the items give. previously % changes were depicted as the total change you would have by getting each item in the chain, now each item only shows the change it specifically gives relative to your current loadout. Also fixed preview hints that gave incorrect information, or was missing information.
New Huge Player "Towers" Tech Tree Screen
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/4f0b4b51983b0b659d5ff38261a67696978194b2.png"]

Stats aren't just for lil' players! Now with a click of the new orange "Towers" button on the bottom toolbar, you can preview all of the available towers in the game! This menu currently only works as a dictionary of info, placing towers still works as it previously did.

Towers have all their stats visible here, with a key to reference what each stat represents.

Prices are listed for each upgrade, and does not include the total cost needed to get to that tower in the train.

The menu can be navigated by clicking the scroll bar, scrolling the mouse wheel, or dragging the content within the window.
Other Various Menu Updates!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/3ce86e076032f576a903f00cb4150d6a37e8b8d2.png"]
Each screen in the main menu has been revamped for aesthetics, and also to get rid of unneeded scrolling throughout these menus. We hope you find these new menus prettier, easier to read, and faster to use!


Other Balance Fixes:
Throughout making all this information visible to the player we noticed some inconsistencies we want to address. many more balance changes will come in a future update, but for now we adjusted the following:

blizzard tower's range has been increased to outperform lower tier ice towers

Jump height code has been restructured. Jump height multipliers will be more reliable now.

Ability Strength Stat has been restructured and buffed. Here is the full list of items/abilites that it impacts:

Enchanted Helm. Activatable Invulnerability time length is based on Ability Strength Stat

Forcefield Bandana. Activatable Forcefield time length is based on Ability Strength Stat

Electro-Magnetic Shoes. *New! Deflector power is now based on Ability Strength Stat! If you have low Ability Strength, the Deflector works the same as it did in previous versions. If you have higher Ability Strength, then projectiles will start getting deflected farther away from yourself, and they will deflect at stronger angles away from you!

Dash (Ninja Bandana) Dash distance is based on Ability Strength

Super Dash (Two Ninja Bandanas) Ability Strength Functions at +50% power for Super Dashes.

notes.title: New Minigames, Bug Fixes & Tower Indicators! - 1.3.4 Update
notes.content:
Hey Topplers! We are back with the first half of the next Topple Tactics content update!


Today we are releasing new Mini-Games for choosing the huge Toppler, as well as some bug fixes and QOL features.

Next up, we are planning to release a UI update for topple tactics! This UI update will make the game UI a lot more informative.

 
Here are today's patch notes:

Two New Huge Toppler Mini Games! 
Fall wall is a plinking drop game where all topplers are flung down a wall of bouncy pillars! First one to the bottom becomes the huge player!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/aadfd06ad7da5aeab5dee5965a1e41cb532c492c.png"]

parkour path is a quick obstacle course, where random platforms will fall out from the path. All players are equipped with double jump shoes and double speed for the mini game

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/b03deea79e9d3422d0a029834e5f9fd2ea5896c2.png"]
Bugs Fixed: 
Fully reworked the hitbox for the electro deflector shoes, they no longer cause the repeated death bug from spawning into acid lab or its variants.

Fixed bug where huge guy would infinitely spawn death particles after dying.


New Features: 
All towers now have a range indicator for the huge player! This circle shows up when placing towers and reappears whenever you hover your mouse over a tower.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/6fc7db755f638195e19dd431e945d466f1bad944.gif"]

Note that the range indicator shows how far projectiles or areas of effect actually impact mini Topplers, some towers (like cannons) will detect topplers and try to shoot at them outside of their range, but in this case the bombs will drop at the edge of the range indicator.

notes.title: Ultimate Towers and 7 New Maps! - 1.3.3.3 Update
notes.content:
Hello Topplers! We have a large content update today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/25e47f119eb4bb9781de4a81e0ab832feff443e8.png

This update DOUBLES the map count in topple tactics! Each map is a variant of one of the previously existing maps, but with a distinct path and feeling.

 Sunset Valley (Topple Lane Variant)
 Blistering Volcano (Magma Lands Variant)
 New Toppleton (Flooded City Variant)
 Radiation Silo (Acid Lab Variant)
 Polar Night (Frozen Wonderland Variant)
 Spaceracer Station (Celestial Citadel Variant)
 Shipwreck Sandbar (Pirates Cove Variant)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/2011708155c9eb97ee6276de9a1ba755108104fb.png

Ultimate towers are extremely strong final upgrades for many of the existing towers in Topple Tactics, each tower introduces a new mechanic to the game!

 Meteor Tower (Cannon Upgrade) - Fires meteors at every Toppler on the map every few seconds, meteors also randomly rain from the sky.
 Mother Gun (Machine Gun Upgrade) - We clearly didn’t have enough bullets. This tower spawns 5 mini machine guns around it.
 Tremor Pillar (Bouncy Pillar Upgrade) - The bounce from this pillar shakes the earth itself, triggers by itself every few seconds, also triggered by players. When triggered, a shockwave comes out of the ground and spreads across the entire map, all Topplers on the ground will be knocked back if touched by the shockwave.
 Ball of Pure Energy (Wrecking Ball Upgrade) - This wrecking ball has gained sentience! Randomly wanders around the map, stalking the closest Toppler if they get close enough, and periodically charging at them.
 Accretion Black Hole (Black Hole Upgrade) - This black hole has attracted meteors, forming a massive accretion disc around it, if a Toppler touches a meteor they will be knocked back.

Only one ultimate tower can exist at once in a game
Currently each ultimate tower upgrades from both crosspaths of each tower. As we add more ultimate towers this will likely stop being the case.

This update also includes minor bug fixes, including fixing cosmetics that were incorrectly rendering on Huge Player.

notes.title: Control Rebinds, Toppler Accessories and more! 1.3.2.9
notes.content:
Hey Topplers! 👋  

We’re working on some cool stuff behind the scenes for Topple Tactics, but in the meantime, here’s a little something to keep things fresh!  

The version number of the new update is 1.3.2.9, if you see a different version number in the main menu and Steam isn’t updating the game for you, the quickest way to get the update is to restart your Steam. If you are still on the old version you will not be able to see games from the new version, so make sure you download the update!

[hr][/hr]

🕹 CONTROL REBINDS  
You can now rebind most controls in the new settings sub-menu! Customize your gameplay the way you like it.  

🎨 SKINS & ACCESSORIES  
A ton of new skins and 20 new Toppler Accessories have been added! You can unlock them through your daily cannon shot.  

Toppler Accessories currently sit on your character's back, head, or face. If you purchase a hat item while being a small toppler, your head toppler item will be replaced by the gameplay hat you equipped.

🐛 BUG FIXES  
We’ve squashed a number of pesky bugs to keep things running smoothly!  

It is now easier to earn medals as a small toppler in the Tug of War gamemode. The requirements are as follows (assuming small topplers win the game):
  - Diamond: You must have K / D ratio of 1.2 / 1 or better AND 15 shots at huge player.
  - Gold: You must have K / D ratio of 1 / 1 or better AND 10 shots at huge player.
  - Silver: You must have K / D ratio of 0.8 / 1 or better AND 5 shots at huge player.
  - Bronze:  You must have K / D ratio of 0.5 / 1 or better.

[hr][/hr]

🚀 Thanks for playing and keep on toppling!  

💙 The Topple Tactics Team

notes.title: New Gamemode! - "Revenge of the Huge Toppler" Update!
notes.content:
IT IS TIME TOPPLERS!

It has been a fantastic year of fighting giants with silly hats, giant shields, and shoes for topplers who don't even have feet! But now we face year 2 of Topple Tactics... and its time for some upgrades.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/e827ea299588f8a3b44d75ed323fbfe731ea6a0e.pngTHE HUGE PLAYER CAN WIN NOW!
What's that? Games stalemating because of a perfect Huge player tower defense? No longer! With this new update, games of Topple Survival can now end early if no players are able to reach the end of the level for over 4 minutes. When that happens, the game automatically ends and the Huge Player claims a victory! 

As a heads up, a timer will show up on everyone's screen when there is only 100 seconds left on the clock. Make sure you actually HIT the huge player before that time! Just shooting out of the cannon won't be enough!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/7536a23338dc17b882d3ab57ffedb9b81cc93f86.png
NEW GAME MODE: TOPPLE TUG OF WAR!
In the spirit of new game rules, we are proud to introduce a mode that directly faces the skill of the little players against the huge player, letting either of them win outright!

In this new mode, the health bar is replaced by a progress bar that starts in the middle. 
 To win the game as a little Toppler, you must reach the end of the level to push the progress bar toward the left, and if the little toppers entirely fill their half of the bar, they win! 
 To win the game as the Huge Toppler, you need to hold off the little players! You slowly regain health over time in this mode, represented by the progress bar slowly moving toward the right side, for a Huge Player Victory! If you can hold off the Little Topplers for long enough and fill your half of the bar, you win!
But let's kick up the challenge: In order to limit hard stomps by one side or the other, this game mode gives progressive buffs to the losing side, to give them a chance at stealing back a victory!

If the huge player progresses 33% of the way to victory (from the middle), Little players will receive a small buff to their passive income, speed, knockback resist, ability strength, and jump height!
If the huge player progresses 66% of the way to victory, most of these little player buffs are doubled!
If the little players are winning instead (by going 33% toward the left of the middle), the Huge player receives more passive income, quickened ability cooldowns, and their towers become stronger
 if the little players progress 66% of the way to victory, the Huge Player's Buffs become even better!
(Exact stats for this new mode are listed below)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/2473aa789d001d1b80d553bebc941112a96d724d.png
NEW SECRET UNLOCKABLES AND THE FINAL WEEKLY CHALLENGE!
The Winter Wonderland enters it's final week! And today we introduce a new free cosmetic type:
TOPPLER ACCESSORIES! For today's update the first added accessories are winter scarves that you can wear with any skin. You'll have to find them hidden in each map! Good luck on the hunt, and look forward to new accessories being added to the daily cannon reward pool in January!

We have chosen to extend the end of the event to Friday January 3rd, to allow players time to play a few more games and unlock more skins! This is your only chance to grab these skins before they are locked away forever. The final weekly event also rewards a full 10,000 xp to help you claim an extra skin before the end of the event.

ChangeLog:
Tug Of War Mode:
- When Huge Player is 33% to victory the little players gain "Phase 1" Buffs:
  Passive Income +30%
  12% Speed Bonus
  +20 Knockback Resist (A flat stat increase instead of a percent)
  +10 Ability Strength (A flat stat increase instead of a percent)
  10% Jump Bonus 
- When Huge Player is 66% to victory the little players gain "Phase 2" Buffs:
  Passive Income +60%
  20% Speed Bonus
  +40 Knockback Resist (A flat stat increase instead of a percent)
  +15 Ability Strength (A flat stat increase instead of a percent)
  20% Jump Bonus 
- When Little Players are 33% to victory the Huge Player gains "Phase 1" Buffs:
  Passive Income +50%
  Ability Cooldowns 15% Faster
  Towers 10% Stronger 
- When Little Players are 66% to victory the Huge Player gains "Phase 1" Buffs:
  Passive Income +50%
  Ability Cooldowns 30% Faster
  Towers 20% Stronger 
- In this mode, little players can earn medals for winning! The ability to earn a medal is based on your K/D (Or more accurately, your "Shoot/Death") ratio and your total number of times shot at the Huge Player:
Diamond Medal: Awarded for K/D >= 2/1 and having a number of kills greater than: (2.5 * player count)
Gold Medal: Awarded for K/D >= 1.6/1 and having a number of kills greater than: (2 * player count)
Silver Medal: Awarded for K/D >= 1.2/1 and having a number of kills greater than: (1.5 * player count)
Bronze Medal: Awarded for K/D >= 1/1 and having a number of kills greater than the number of players in the game.
- Huge Player Medals in this mode are rewarded as follows:
Diamond Medal: Winning in under 4 minutes, & at least 20 little Toppler kills in the match.
Gold Medal: Winning in under 7 minutes, & at least 10 little Toppler kills in the match.
Silver Medal: Winning in under 10 minutes, & at least 7 little Toppler kills in the match.
Bronze Medal: Winning at all, & at least 5 little Toppler kills in the match.
Survival Mode:
If 4 minutes passes in game without anyone reaching the end orb, the game immediately ends as a huge player victory.
A warning countdown clock appears for the last 100 seconds to let little players know how much time they have left to try and win.
Balance Changes:
 Spiky Cleats price changed from 80 -> 60 topple coins. And they now resist ice effect and wind effect while on the ground AND while in the air. Spikey Cleats also now work against Ice cannon, which was a bug previously.
Steel shoes now preserve 50% speed boost when upgrading from running shoes, instead of removing all speed boost.
Metal Shoes with holes and Chunky shoes both benefit from this preserved speed boost, making them both faster.
Aeroplane hat 400% fall speed reduction reduced to 300%


The Dev team wants to thank all our players who have given their feedback in our Discord server! We look forward to hearing your experience with the new update and will make any balance changes needed as the players interact with the new content!

notes.title: Winter Wonderland Event Begins!
notes.content:
Hello Topplers! 
Our three-week winter event starts today! Jump into Topple Tactics this month and earn holiday-themed skins in a FREE event pass!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/2473aa789d001d1b80d553bebc941112a96d724d.png

As you do in-game actions like winning games, launching yourself at the huge guy, or earning medals, you'll be earning xp toward the Winter Wonderland event pass. Once you meet the xp required for a skin you unlock it!

Through the month there will also be 3 event challenges that take longer to complete and give a flat sum of xp when completed. Today the first challenge is unlocked: Earn 20,000 topple tokens! Each wednesday a new event challenge will become available!

An Event That Keeps On Giving!
Over the course of this event the winter wonderland gets better and better!

- Next Weekend levels will become holiday themed!
- The week after that we will reveal a new cosmetic to unlock: Accessories!
- The final week will include a surprise game update!

Game Updates too?!
Yes! A new gamemode is currently in the final stages of testing and we plan to release it during this event!
This new tug-of-war style gamemode more directly challenges the Huge player vs. Little players, as they push and pull the progress bar toward one side winning and the other losing! In this way, the Huge player can finally win directly!

What About the Standard Gamemode?
We've heard your feedback! In Topple Survival, when the Huge player makes a good enough defense, it becomes a never-ending game! Coming this month is an update to help end stalemate games as a Huge player victory! We aim to keep the pre-existing value of diamond medal timings (and maybe make them MORE unique!)

Thank you to everyone who plays our game and gives feedback on our Discord Server!
Its thanks to the bug reports and suggestions from that server that we get to know what the players are thinking and help us make this game the best version of itself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/bfa26fb15703f226a564d8a99d98f66a46b2c709.png
The current game version is 1.3.1.16. If Steam won't update the game for you, the quickest way to get the new version is to restart your Steam client.

notes.title: Topple Tactics 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello Topplers! Today is Topple Tactic’s birthday! Let’s celebrate one year of floppy tower-defense chaos, and talk about the future of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/edec205734207b6d4ecdd63c08ae5b5b170b7bc2.png
Log into the game this week and you’ll redeem the free 1st Anniversary skin gift! Our players have collectively earned thousands of medals over the past year, and this skin shows off all the dedicated toppling you’ve accomplished!

Let’s take a look down memory lane.. 
We’ve rumbled through achievements and skin cosmetics bringing new flair to the game. We gained more control of how we play, with lobby settings, game modifiers, huge player choosing mini games, and the faster-paced game mode Topple Takeover! We got two new maps with Pirate’s Cove and Celestial Citadel, and we finally got to talk to each other with the in-game chat feature! Flop mode increased the chaos originally planned for the game, and the art update brought each level to a colorful completion!

Huge players gained new towers, mini players gained new items, and all along the way we’ve been balancing the game and fixing bugs (especially when it came to the bug fixing update!) But we couldn’t have done it without the support of our players! We especially want to thank all the players who have reported bugs to us and offered game ideas through our discord server! Indie game development on a multiplayer game has been an amazing and challenging journey, and it’s made all the better when we can directly communicate with the players!

What’s Next!?
Year 2 of Topple Tactics starts now! We’ve learned a ton over the past year, and we’re excited to bring new content to you Topplers!

This week we will unveil our newest free event, with more things to unlock compared to our previous Christmas and Pirate events. 

We have also been working behind the scenes on a major gameplay flow update to tackle those slowdown periods of gameplay. Our private playtest of this new game balancing has made the team very excited and we look forward to finishing that update!

After that? More content! Our players have given us lots of ideas for new maps, towers, and mini player items, and we can’t wait to start developing more in game goals, and tools to accomplish those goals!

Topple on!

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.3.1.8, September 16th 2024
notes.content:
Hello Topplers, this patch is the huge bug fix patch that we promised! A ton of the long-standing bugs in the game have been fixed. 

Patch Notes:

Connection Fixes:

- Once a game host leaves, players no longer get kicked back to the main menu. The game is automatically recreated with all of the remaining players with a new host that is randomly chosen by Steam. Tackling this problem and host migration is a massive task with the way the game was originally written, and this is our first step towards tackling this problem. Over time, the aim is to completely eliminate this problem.
- The game now automatically detects if the lobby you are joining is a ghost lobby, and returns the player to the main menu.

Gameplay Fixes:

- Fixed a bug which caused medals to sometimes not get awarded.
- Fixed a bug that would sometimes trigger two deaths in your stats when you only died once.
- Fixed the middle rooftop in flooded city from having weird collision and sometimes getting you stuck
- Fixed fallen tree in flooded city. You can now jump off of it.
- Fixed projectiles traveling through walls/terrain in all levels.
- While in flop mode, using a bandana dash now turns off flop mode and lets the legs gain traction again.(developer note: we are looking into methods for little players to take control of the intentional chaos that flop mode and the game's physics engine create. Dashing won't save you with this change alone. You'll still be flying off in whatever direction you were launched, but now some situations that would be deadly, such as falling off of an edge or near landable ground, can be saved with a well placed dash... and maybe some double jumps.)

Huge Player Chooser Fixes:

- The last piece of the Topple Island minigame will now also fall after the others, instead of staying up until the timer runs out.
- The order of the falling pieces is now set by a new randomizer algorithm, which should ensure every possible order is equally likely to happen, instead of some patterns previously being more likely than others.
- Fixed the Random Choosinator from soft-locking a lobby when the player it chose to be the big guy left the lobby before it revealed the winner.

Main Menu/UI Fixes:

- Lobby buttons in the "join a Lobby" menu are now fixed. (The hoverable area of the "settings" button was offset from the visual button, causing misclicks to the wrong lobby)
- Fixed the lobby info panel previously being visible when not hovering over a lobby settings button.
- Formatted lobby info panel be easier to read at a glance
- Fixed Title text overlapping description text for some skins in the customisation menu.
- Added a clickable scroll bar to customisation menu.
- If you own duplicates of the exact same skin, those duplicates are now condensed to one entry in the list, with a number indicating how many of that skin you own.
- The [Esc] keyboard button now always brings you to the main menu when in a sub-menu. In the main menu, [Esc] toggles the settings menu.
- The clickable back button has now been moved to the bottom left for every sub-menu screen except the daily reward cannon where it's still in the bottom center of the screen.

Daily Reward Cannon Fixes:

- Countdown timer now works correctly. It no longer resets after every played match.
- The Daily cannon can now be used multiple times in a row. (assuming you have multiple daily reward crates to unbox. Daily Reward Crates are the actual thing the game gives you at the end of a match, The daily reward cannon menu is just the place you unbox those crates) Previously you would have to close out of the entire game, or go into a match and back out to reset the menu.
- Daily Reward Cannon menu page now shows how many daily reward crates you have in your inventory to unbox.
- made the clickable button in the main menu only highlight when you have something to unbox.

Chat Fixes:

- As huge player, Pressing spacebar while typing in chat will no longer accidentally sell a tower your mouse was hovering over.
- As small player, initiating chat while holding a movement button will no longer lock you into moving in that direction while chatting.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.3.1.4, May 19th 2024
notes.content:
Hello Topplers! The next update for Topple Tactics is now LIVE!!

We end summer with a new update containing a few item changes and community requested balance changes! 

The version number of the new update is 1.3.1.4, if you see a different version number in the main menu and Steam isn’t updating the game for you, the quickest way to get the update is to restart your Steam. If you are still on the old version you will not be able to see games from the new version, so make sure you download the update!

Patch Notes:

The forcefield from the Forcefield bandana no longer gets targeted by towers. It’s duration has been changed:

 From: 4 seconds (at min ability strength) - 8 seconds (at max ability strength)  
 To: 2 seconds (at min ability strength - 10 seconds (at max ability strength)

The spiky cleats have been added to the game! These shoes provide a complete immunity to ice and wind effects whilst grounded.

The antimatter shoe drawback has been lowered in intensity.

The regeneration shield now regenerates 4 health every tick instead of 1, however it’s health has been lowered to compensate.

The Enchanted helm now actually makes you invincible. You can no longer take health damage, enter flop mode or get knocked up by cannon shots when under its effects.

The nebula shield health has been raised significantly. The idea is that it’s not very protective but almost acts like a permanent barrier. If used correctly, it should reward players with high skill at utilising their shields.

The cost of the slingshot has been decreased to 4 tokens from 5, and its power has been increased slightly. It has also been decoupled from the cannon/machinegun tree to make upgrading less frustrating. The idea behind the slingshot is to allow it to act as a spammable, throwaway tower for the Mega Toppler to use in a pinch.

Income tick size has been increased for the Mega Toppler in topple survival, to compensate, the bursts of income during phase changes have been lowered slightly. This means the Mega Toppler will spend less time “sitting around doing nothing” during the game.

Silver and Gold sweepers have been made to spin slightly faster to make upgrading to those levels more worth it. The top levels of spinner have also been made slightly faster.

The groundinator now shoots slightly smaller bursts, but shoots them more often.

The bouncy pillar cost has been lowered to 6 from 7, the upgrade cost for the silver and gold bouncy pillar has been lowered to 3 from 5.

The wide shields has been replaced with the round shield. A shield that protects the Toppler from most angles!

The pirate event skins have been made unobtainable.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.3.1.2, 18th August 2024
notes.content:
Hello Topplers!

The next Topple Tactics update, 1.3.1.2, is now live!

We wanted to take a moment to share some insights into the ongoing development of Topple Tactics. We understand that the recent updates have sparked mixed reactions within our community, and we genuinely appreciate the clarity and usefulness of feedback we've received, in particular from the game's Discord server.

Many of the recent decisions were made to ensure Topple Tactics wouldn't stick to single repetitive metas. We want to make Toppler equipment and tower choices matter more in gameplay. This recent update just started that process. We want to improve the specialization and identity of each tower and mini guy item/stat, and also ensure that our intent for these items are properly represented in game and out of game.

In an ideal version of Topple Tactics, sticking to a single build type as a mini guy (only tank, only speed, only fall speed reduction) should make you exceptionally strong against certain towers and quite vulnerable to others. No single tech path should be the solution to all huge guy tower layouts (except perhaps maxing out every little guy stat!). These recent changes aren't perfect reflections of our final goal, but they are here to test how certain ideas feel when mixed into the game.

Regarding flop mode, it was always a goal for this game to have a layer of chaos. We intentionally want this game to have chaotic party-game energy along an undertone of competitive strategy. We will continue to adjust flop mode to better fit the game. There’s a balance to be struck: ensuring that a mixed-build mini Toppler can reasonably avoid being flopped (or has good recovery if they spec into the right equipment), while also ensuring that a picking the wrong build (or even an intentionally risky one) for the towers at hand will send you flying. 

We are very invested in having fun synergies in the game, both with tower synergies and mini Toppler item synergies. We’ve heard your concerns about the loss of the ice and black hole synergy. It had become too powerful in its previous state, but it is not forgotten.

Recently, we had a team meeting to discuss the ideal identity and “fun” of each playstyle. We will reveal these concepts once they are fully fleshed out, but we also recognize that a backlog of bugs have become frustrating in the face of feature creep.

We are committed to addressing these bugs immediately, and from our research into them, some of them will require drastic overhauls of how certain systems in the game function (like server connections).

When it comes to what we develop next, we want to fix these bugs, whilst also testing balance ideas so that the game can be "unbalanced" for as short of a period as possible. Our goal is to ensure that Topple Tactics remains a dynamic and enjoyable experience for all players, whether you want to play competitively, or just goof off and have fun.

This update mainly centers around adjusting the balancing issues and fixing bugs relating to the recent flop update.


That being said, here are the patch notes!


Pirate event! - There are two limited edition pirate-themed skins available to unlock! Go to the event details page in the main menu for more details.

Big guy zoom - Using the scroll wheel, you can zoom in the big toppler’s view. You can then pan the camera by hovering the mouse to the screen edges or using the arrow keys / WASD

Black hole changes - The black hole now ignores knockback resist and has been made stronger overall

Shield changes - Changed some multipliers around how shield health was calculated, leading to very similar final health for all with a maxed out build. Shields now have the appropriate amount of health. The health of all shields has been buffed.

Wrecking ball - The wrecking ball has been nerfed to be weaker against tank builds. The higher your knockback resist stat, the more the wrecking ball gets stopped in its tracks when it hits a toppler. Previously, only the knockback value itself was affected leading to similar knockback regardless of build.

Sweeper knockback has been lowered slightly

Slightly lowered effects of wind on speed build, there is no longer an “acceleration” feeling to it

The ninja headband now allows you to instantly change direction when used. It will push the player towards the direction the camera is looking

Bombs fired from cannons now travel slightly slower

Double cannon fire rate has been lowered slightly

Tank item changes

 Chunky shoes now give immunity to flop mode
 Colossus helm now gives immunity to taking extra knockback if your health is lowered


Bug Fixes:
Fixed the player still sometimes getting hit when their forcefield was still active, this should happen significantly less often now

The slingshot icon now goes red if the big toppler has less than 5 tokens, rather than 15 tokens previously

Fixed the player getting stuck in flop mode when smacked into a wall

Stopped cannons and other towers excessively knocking the player up

Changed hitboxes of shields so they should get stuck less often and give the toppler slightly more mobility

Added extra precautions to stop toppler’s legs going out of alignment

Daily Item Wheel fixes:

 The daily item wheel now makes sure steam is responsive before letting you press the “Daily Reward” button. Preventing failed spin attempts.
 Made the wheel spin shorter.

notes.title: The FLOP Update! - Update Notes for 1.3, Jul 21st 2024
notes.content:
Hello Topplers! Thank you for your continued support of the game! We have a large update for you this time around. We have done our best to address as many concerns as possible and will continue to do so as we carry on working on the game. We have also added many new features! Here are the patch notes:

Maps
Map Graphics/Art Update
The models and graphics of every single map have been reworked!

New Map 
A completely new map, the Pirates Cove, has been added to the game, including a new soundtrack made by Tim Haywood!

Mini Toppler
Knockback Rework
The way knockback works has been completely changed from the ground up. Overall it should now feel a lot more consistent. Speed no longer gives a massive advantage against being knocked back, meaning only building speed is now a “glass cannon” kind of build as originally intended. The knockback rework has also made knockback resistance way more useful, maxing out knockback resistance now actually provides a very significant reduction in the amount of knockback you take, knockback resist also makes you take a lot less health damage! Knockback should also feel a lot more predictable now, getting hit by a cannon for example, should provide an equal amount of knockback regardless of the direction the mini Toppler is facing (providing all other factors, like health level and knockback resistance level are the same).

Health system
A new health system has been added to the mini Toppler! Taking knockback now takes away health, health passively regenerates constantly even whilst being hit. The less health you have, the more knockback you take. If your health gets too low, it will enter “critical mode” where you must not take damage for a few seconds in order for it to regenerate. Whilst in critical mode, you are most susceptible to knockback and more towers can initiate “Flop Mode”.

Flop Mode
Flop mode is exactly what it sounds like! The mini player can actually properly flop now! Some knockback sources, like the wrecking ball, laser and giant bouncy pillar, will initiate flop mode regardless of health. But once your health reaches “critical mode”, other towers, like cannons and all levels of the bouncy pillar, will also be able to initiate flop mode.

Shield Rework

Rebalanced how much damage towers do to shields (cannons, wrecking balls, spinners and bouncy pillars now do more damage to shields).

Increased the health of shields across the board.

Health Bars
Added a pair of health bars to the bottom of the mini Toppler UI. One indicating health, and one indicating shield health. These hide if you have not recently taken damage.

Huge Toppler
Some weak towers have been reworked

The Fanatron 3000 now shoots air in every single direction, instead of just 3 directions. So if you are near it, no matter what, you will be pushed away.

The triple machine gun as it was before has been removed from the game and replaced with a different tower completely. The new version fires homing bullets!

The ice cannon now has a pretty large AOE effect and fires more often. It can also shoot through shields.

Since the way knockback works has been changed significantly, all towers have been rebalanced to fit the knockback rework.

Slingshot
A new tower, the “Slingshot” has been added to the game! It serves as a cheap base projectile tower, only costing 5 tokens, and upgrades to the original base level cannon and machine gun for a further 10 tokens. This means the big toppler now has something to place in a pinch if they only have a few tokens lying around.

Other Balancing
Fixed an issue which made black holes much more powerful around ice towers. This is still the case, but it has been dialled back slightly.

The blizzard tower radius has been increased.

Bugs
Fixed the random choosinator causing the game to freeze if the person chosen to be the mega player left the game (please confirm that this works as it may need further attention).

Fixed some unintended behaviour in sandbox mode if you joined it after leaving a multiplayer game.

Skins       
6 new skin patterns have been added to the daily cannon, with a combined 56 color versions!


Next day patch (22/07/2024)
Hey Topplers! A few bugs and issues that arose with last night's update have been fixed, the changes are live now and the latest version is now 1.3.0.3

- Black holes have been slightly buffed across the board.
- Fixed legs acting strangely in the Pirates Cove map.
- The lowest 3 levels of wrecking ball no longer cause guaranteed flop mode if you’ve purchased a knockback resist item.
- Fixed edges of the screen staying red sometimes after you take damage as the Mini Toppler.

notes.title: New Gamemode! "TOPPLE TAKEOVER" - Update notes for 1.2, Apr 14 2024
notes.content:
Hello Topplers!

Thank you all so much for all the love and feedback you have given us on the game! We are very grateful for all of you who have jumped on the beta tests, and the feedback from reported bugs and gameplay suggestions on our discord server have been fantastic! It's been amazing communicating with you all as we work hard on updating this game and bringing more fixes, additions, and content!

The version number of the new update is 1.2.0.5, if you still see 1.1.4.7 in the main menu and Steam isn’t updating the game for you, the quickest way to get the update is to restart your Steam. If you are still on the old version you will not be able to see games from the new version, so make sure you download the update!

TOPPLE TAKEOVER! (New Gamemode)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/847a97c4e805e4ae597ca28b98f8478cb2906106.png
Tired of only one player being the Huge Toppler per game? This new gamemode is here to switch things up! In Topple Takeover, when a Little Toppler reaches the end of the level, they become the Huge Toppler! It's a battle between all players to see who can stay as the Huge Toppler for the longest amount of time!  


New Cosmetic System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43974980/02dbd012e172b6f5f92ec50d7098acb7717dd59f.png
We ripped out some code and put some new code in! For the rest of this game's life, your in-game skins are now items that you can see in your Steam Inventory! (And show off on your steam profile)

This allows us to introduce The Daily Reward.

After playing a round of Topple Tactics, you can redeem your daily reward in the main menu, and Steam will gift you one of the new 130 skins added to the game! Each skin has a rarity based on how complex the skin's design is. Common skins are flat colors, Uncommon and Rare skins provide multi-color patterns, and Epic or Legendary skins will have either unique 3D models or unique shaders.

The Daily Reward will never give out skins earned through achievements or challenges. It also will never give out limited-time unlockables, like last year's holiday secret. If you get a skin you don't like (like a duplicate) you can trade them with other steam users, or put them up for sale on the steam marketplace!

This new system also allows us to solve a longstanding request: Skins unlocked through challenges no longer have to ALWAYS to be attached to achievements! We know a lot of players didn't get to unlock the secret skin available during the holiday season. With this new system, we can still have limited-time cosmetics exist without locking players out from having 100% achievement completion.

(We will not yet be removing the secret achievement until we are certain that the secret holiday skin has successfully migrated into the inventories of all the players who unlocked it. Just make sure to boot up the update, and check your steam inventory after you close the game. If you have all of your unlocked skins in your inventory, then you will not lose them in the future.)

Now that the steam inventory is established, we can work on adding new fun ways to unlock skins! Stay tuned as we introduce more challenge-based unlockables in future updates!

1.2 Patch Notes:

Topple Takeover Gamemode

 When the huge player is chosen in the lobby, everyone will load in and receive a set amount of topple tokens to buy upgrades.
 There will be a 20 second buying period during which the Huge Toppler buys all of their towers, and all the mini topplers buy all of their upgrades
 At the end of this buying period, the map opens up. The first mini toppler to reach the end becomes the new mega toppler!
 Every round, topplers receive more and more tokens, allowing you to try more and more elaborate strategies.
 Every second survived as a huge toppler awards you with one point. The game lasts 10 minutes, at the end of the game, the player with the most points wins!

Cosmetics Updates

 Added Steam Inventory functionality.
 Added New Cosmetics menu with collapsible tabs for each rarity type.
 Added a "Daily Reward" item, which is gifted into your inventory on completion of a round. This item gets traded out in the main menu.
 Added the "Daily Reward" button in the main menu. When you click it, your "Daily Reward" item is "unboxed" and converts into a random new cosmetic.
 Drop rates for the "Daily Reward" skins are as follows: Common: 35%, Uncommon: 35%, Rare: 25%, Epic: 4%, Legendary: 1%
 Added 19 new Common skin colors.
 Added 7 new patterns for skins of Uncommon or Rare quality, each with at least 10 color variants, totaling 107 added skins of Uncommon or Rare.
 Added 4 Epic skins, each a different style of a "Hoodie Toppler"
 Added the first "Daily Reward" Legendary skin: BANANA.

Fixes

 Fixed some long standing bugs

notes.title: Update notes for 1.1.4, Jan 13 2024
notes.content:
Hello Topplers!

The next update for Topple Tactics is live!

The version number of the new update is 1.1.4.5, if you still see 1.0.3.3 in the main menu and Steam isn’t updating the game for you, the quickest way to get the update is to restart your Steam. If you are still on the old version you will not be able to see games from the new version, so make sure you download the update!

Patch Notes:

Lobby settings - You can now choose exactly which maps, minigames and modifiers will appear in the game when creating a lobby!

Game modifiers - you can now select a bunch of random modifiers to be applied at the start of games (low gravity, fast-forward mode, lightweight mini guys etc). They are all disabled by default so you must manually enable them in the lobby creation screen. If you like them, there will be a bunch more cool modifiers added in the future!

Knockback resist now helps against the grounding knockback of the grounder tower tree, whereas before it completely ignored it. 

A number of exploits have been fixed (thanks for reporting them!).

Medal stats now update even if the host leaves before the game ends, and update sequentially (if you survive 20 minutes you will get 1 of each medal).

Electromagnetic shoes now actually work like they’re supposed to and properly bend projectiles around you.

Did a blind fix to try and stop the mini toppler’s legs from getting stuck in the floor occasionally (MOOORE COLLIDERS!).

Fixed only the host getting bonus points for damaging the huge guy, all players should get the bonus points now.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.1.3, Dec 14 2023
notes.content:
Hello Topplers!

The first CONTENT update for Topple Tactics is live!

Patch Notes:

- New Tower! The Grounder, the shots of this tower are weak against topplers on the ground, but slam airborne topplers downwards. Upgrades to the anti-air missile launcher which fires homing missiles, and The Groundinator, which unleashes a massive amount of bullets every few seconds.

- New Map! The new space-themed map, Celestial Citadel, along with its soundtrack, have been added to the game!

- 2 new minigames for choosing the big toppler!

- New skins! Getting achievements and reaching certain stat milestones will now unlock special skins! There will be many more skins to come in future updates!

- Stats! A new stat page has been added to the main menu, where you can track things like total medals earned, total kills/deaths and more. Unfortunatley, since I have only just added them, stats will start counting from now. So everyone gets a fresh start!

- Achievements! 14 achievements have been added to the game.

- New items! Double jump boots, Cloud boots and Electromagnetic boots!

- The aeroplane hat has been nerfed slightly, it allows flight for 5 seconds before slowly lowering you back to the ground.

- A few parts of the late game scaling have been altered, topplers will receive less knockback resist over time, and sweepers will slow down much less over time.

- Anti cheat has been improved.

- A few more small changes / tweaks.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.2.3, Nov 5 2023
notes.content:
Hello Topplers!

The first update for Topple Tactics is now Live!

This update is a bug-fix update, just to iron out anything I missed before the game released. Not all bugs are fixed, but a lot of the annoying ones are. In the next update (which I am already actively working on! ) I will fix more of the current bugs, as well as add a lot of new exciting content!

Patch Notes:
The game should lag much less if a bunch of people try to connect to the same game
The game shouldn’t kick you out randomly when loading in to a new scene (unless the lobby actually closes or you actually disconnect)
Fixed the pop-up telling you that you have an outdated version of the game when trying to join a friend’s game sometimes, it should now say the actual reason you couldn’t connect, which was that the game was still being created
Fixed mini dudes not being able to see the forcefield bandana’s visual effects
Fixed the bug where you couldn’t sell a tower if you right-clicked it after it was max level
The center of a black hole no longer contains a collider
The shop no longer gets stuck open sometimes
Shadows no longer contain lines
Frozen Wonderland and Magma Lands should be more difficult to skip (adjusted the collider in the obstacles to be taller)
The leaderboard should no longer sometimes contain a bunch of empty player objects which would sometimes overflow outside of the bounds of the match stats menu
The disconnect menu no longer gets stuck open if you enter a match without closing it. It should now close automatically
Fixed an exploit

Happy Toppling!!
